messages:
maria: Quick sync — product decision for chat completions: do we standardize on messages[] (role+content) as the primary shape or keep the legacy prompt param as first-class? Customers keep asking for deterministic system role enforcement and reliable structured output. Thoughts?
vikram: messages[] is cleaner for roles and tool-calling. it maps well to function-calls and structured outputs. prefer messages[] as default, but need a migration/alias for prompt.
kevin: +1 for messages[]. big customer ask: prevent users from silently overriding system instructions. we should have a default immutability for system role (configurable per org).
samir: ergonomics note — for quickstarts we should accept a single string prompt and translate to messages internally. keeps onboarding smooth while nudging users to messages[].
maria: Proposed launch criteria: 1) messages[] GA as primary surface; 2) prompt accepted as alias for compatibility; 3) system role pinned by default (enterprise can opt into override policies); 4) function/tool calling works with both shapes.
vikram: Also need structured output story — a `schema` or `format` param. customers want JSON-schema enforcement + soft validation (warnings). tie this into Redwood Optimize/Quality monitoring.
kevin: Implementation note: backend should canonicalize prompt->messages in routing layer. perf delta should be negligible. require migration guide and SDK helpers (e.g., client.prompt -> client.messages). deprecations timeline needs to be clear.
maria: Prioritization (tentative): 1) messages[] + system enforcement, 2) prompt alias + SDK helpers, 3) structured schema support, 4) telemetry + evals and migration metrics. Can we target a beta in ~6 weeks?
samir: 6 weeks is tight but possible if eng-runtime reuses existing parsing. I'll pull in eng-runtime and eng-platform. @vikram can you draft a compatibility plan with specific dev tasks?
vikram: Yep — will draft a short compatibility doc. Will include examples and a migration checklist. Snippet I'll include in the doc:

```
# preferred messages[] shape
messages = [
  {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
  {"role": "user", "content": "Summarize the following text."}
]

# prompt alias
prompt = "Summarize the following text."
```
deploy-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.docs/internal/chat/messages-vs-prompt-compatibility — assigned to @vikram :tada:
maria: Thanks — can we also prepare a short FAQ for customer legal/security teams explaining system role immutability and how enterprise can opt into override policies?
kevin: I'll draft the FAQ bullets. also adding telemetry flags: `system_overridden` and `prompt_used` so PM/eng can track adoption and problematic overrides.
maria: Great — let's regroup after draft. If eng OKs 6-week beta, we'll sync on rollout plan and customer invites.
